The identifier of the trusted service.

title.zh: 移除可信服务的委派管理员账号

descriptions.zh: 如果被移除的委派管理账号在可信服务中存在历史管理任务，移除操作可能对可信服务的正常使用产生影响。请在移除前慎重考虑可能产生的影响，然后再进行移除操作。
descriptions.en: If the delegated administrator account that you want to remove has historical management tasks in the related trusted service, the trusted service may be affected after the delegated administrator account is removed. Therefore, proceed with caution.
